name: Kaizuka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kaizuka city emblem in maroon: an outlined five-pointed star enclosing a stylised swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Kaizuka, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted in August 1971; the emblem dates from 29 August 1943.

features.role: Kaizuka city emblem — an outlined five-pointed star enclosing a stylised swirl
